text:
sam_sales: Northshore bank asks: 6-week POC, Canada-only for inference, logs, and backups. BYOK w/ customer HSM. Must exclude EU and APAC from any data path. Also need list of subprocessors that could see request metadata, retention rules for backups, and delta pricing vs hosted. Timeline for peering + key onboarding? @leo_infra @maya_sec @raj_legal

leo_infra: Quick note: hosted API cannot guarantee strict region isolation for control-plane telemetry. Two viable options: 1) Private single-region deploy (best isolation, customer-managed control plane + BYOK HSM), 2) Dedicated tenant pinned to ca-central-1 with deny-rules and disabled cross-region pref. If they forbid failover entirely we should use Private.

leo_infra: Sample human routing policy:
```
tenant_pin: ca-central-1
allowed_regions: [ca-central-1]
deny_regions: [eu-*, ap-*, us-west-2]
failover: []
```

maya_sec: We can provide a redacted subprocessor matrix filtered to Canada without NDA (high-level cloud infra name, logging provider, monitoring). Full inventory requires NDA. Backups: by default snapshots may be replicated for durability; for CA-only we need a config to disable cross-region replication or use Private. Retention/backup encryption: we can support customer-managed keys for snapshots in Private. Key onboarding + attestation: typically 7-15 business days.

raj_legal: We can sign a limited "no EU/APAC egress" amendment for the POC but need to define exceptions (security patch metadata, legal requests, emergency telemetry). Ask their counsel to confirm scope. NDA required before full subproc list. Also need to confirm whether backups being "CA-only" includes offsite DR copies.

peering_ops: For peering we'll need CIDRs, ASN, bandwidth, and TLS SANs. Interconnect lead time depends on carrier: expect 3-10 business days. If they want private connectivity to a Private deployment, add provisioning window. Note: single-region Private avoids cross-region egress charges; Dedicated with failover allowed will incur cross-region egress on failover.

leo_infra: Ballpark pricing for a 6-week POC: Private single-region w/ customer HSM ~$32k total (includes onboarding, snapshot config, short-term infra). Dedicated pinned POC w/ managed-HSM ~$18k/month pro-rated + HSM add-on ~$3.5k/mo + one-time peering ~$1.5k. Exact depends on GPU profile, log retention, and snapshot frequency.

maya_sec: I'll prepare a CA-filtered subproc summary and a note on which services may touch metadata (ingress LB, logs pipeline). Will also add recommended SIEM integration patterns (in-region syslog forwarding or S3 bucket export).

raj_legal: I'll draft NDA + POC amendment language for "no egress" and clarify DR/backups exceptions. Need bank legal contact.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created ticket PRESALES-8112 -> northshore-ca-poc-byo-hsm, assigned to infra + peering.

sam_sales: Thanks team. I'll send NDA + security questionnaire to their counsel and confirm whether they allow any warm standby (us-east) or absolutely not. Please DM formal quote and an ops checklist I can paste into the SOW. :thumbsup:
